English · فارسی

Iran MCP servers: iran-mcp

Give your AI agent the Iranian web.
68 unofficial, open-source Persian-web MCP servers for Digikala, Torob, Divar, Snappfood, Jabama, MrBilit, Alibaba, Neshan, Balad, Paziresh24, Taaghche, Jobinja, Bama, the Tehran stock exchange, Codal, the Central Bank, Iranian crypto exchanges, the tax administration, qavanin.ir laws and more, plus official ones from ExirYab, Pasavard and SwapWallet.
Search, compare prices in Toman, find free slots and today's deals from Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot in VS Code or any MCP client.
Install them as Claude Code plugins with skills, or as Agent Skills for Codex, Cursor, Antigravity and Grok Build.

Web catalog (in Persian): mcpfarsi.ir, the Persian MCP marketplace.

What's new · Quick start · The servers · For AI agents · All tools · FAQ

What's new in v2.3

  • 31 new servers, all read-only and without sign-in: 71 servers and 883 tools in total.
  • Cars: bama-ir-mcp, karnameh-mcp and hamrah-mechanic-mcp (car ads, daily and new-car prices), plus sheypoor-mcp classifieds.
  • Maps and travel: neshan-mcp and balad-mcp (places, nearby search, directions with live traffic), alibaba-ir-mcp (flights, trains, buses, hotels, villas, tours) and eghamat24-mcp (hotels).
  • Jobs and freelance: jobinja-mcp, jobvision-mcp, irantalent-mcp, quera-mcp, ponisha-mcp and karlancer-mcp.
  • Markets and economy: codal-mcp (company filings), ifb-mcp (bonds and sukuk), fipiran-mcp (funds), ime-mcp (commodity exchange), cbi-mcp (Central Bank rates) and amar-mcp (official statistics). Most of these quote Rial, and several answer only Iranian connections.
  • Shops, books, courses and health: emalls-ir-mcp, mobile-ir-mcp, zoomit-mcp, iranketab-mcp, faradars-mcp and darukade-mcp (online pharmacy).
  • Sports, games, calendar and records: varzesh3-mcp, gamefa-mcp, time-ir-mcp, rrk-mcp (Official Gazette) and iran-cloud-status-mcp (ArvanCloud, Hamravesh, Chabokan, Liara).
  • New bundles iran-cars, iran-maps, iran-jobs, iran-freelance, iran-economy, iran-stocks, iran-classifieds, iran-learning and iran-law.
  • Tool names and parameters of the existing servers are unchanged.

Full list: CHANGELOG.md.

What's new in v2.0
  • 12 new servers, all read-only and without sign-in: 36 servers and 469 tools in total.
  • Shops and food: basalam-mcp (thousands of small shops), banimode-mcp (fashion), baneh-mcp (appliances, TVs, tools) and tapsifood-mcp (dishes and deals near an address).
  • Prices, news and public records: tgju-mcp (gold, coin, currency and crypto), iran-news-mcp (10 news sources, plus a tech-news tool), iran-quake-mcp (earthquakes), qavanin-mcp (national laws) and iran-tax-mcp (e-invoice IDs, VAT rates, tax rulings).
  • Courses, apps and software: maktabkhooneh-mcp (its tools start with mkh_), iran-apps-mcp (Cafe Bazaar and Myket) and iran-downloads-mcp (download-site search, item page only, never a download link).
  • New bundles iran-fashion and iran-software.
  • Tool names and parameters of the existing servers are unchanged.

Full list: CHANGELOG.md.

What's new in v1.7
  • Fewer blocks and failed calls. The 18 unofficial shop servers now talk to each site like a normal browser, pace their requests and wait when a site asks them to slow down. On Torob the old client was blocked after 4-6 calls; the new one made 100 without a block.
  • Proxy lists. <NAME>_MCP_PROXY takes several proxies, separated by commas. When one is blocked, the next takes over.
  • Optional browser fallback for sites that show a bot-check page: install <package>[browser].
  • New: torob-mcp (every Iranian shop's price for one product), pasavard-mcp (hosted, best buys per budget) and exiryab-mcp (ExirYab's own doctor finder).
  • Tool names and parameters are unchanged.

Full list: CHANGELOG.md.

What's new in v1.5
  • About 62% fewer tokens per tool call and a 19% smaller tool list across the 19 package servers, with the same rankings and cheapest prices as before.
  • Security hardening in 30book, Bale and Okala, and site text is treated as untrusted in every server.
  • Caches, parallel requests and retries where the servers were slow or fragile.
  • New: divar-mcp, 31 tools for Divar classifieds: homes, cars, phones, fair-price checks and new-ad alerts.

Full list, including changes for callers: CHANGELOG.md.

Why

Iranian websites are not built for AI agents. Most have no public API, prices come in Rial on one page and Toman on the next, and every site hides its best deals behind a different menu. Each package server here maps one site's real (undocumented) API, tests it, and exposes it as clean MCP tools with prices in Toman. exiryab-mcp, pasavard-mcp and swapwallet-mcp are the sites' own servers, built on their documented APIs.

Put a few of them together and one sentence does a day of tab-hopping (illustrative example):

You: I'm flying Tehran to Kish next Thursday for 3 nights. Cheapest flight, a villa under 4 million Toman a night, and a dermatologist on the island with a free slot.

Agent: calls mrbilit for flights → jabama and otaghak for stays → paziresh24 for doctors

Pick Price (Toman)
Flight Thursday 07:40, economy, 2 seats left 2,180,000
Stay 2-bedroom villa near the beach, 4.8 stars 3,650,000 / night
Doctor Dermatologist, Saturday 10:30, in-person 450,000

Quick start

Every server is a small Python package on PyPI, run with uvx, except pasavard-mcp and swapwallet-mcp, which their sites host: you add them by URL, and sign in to SwapWallet once with OAuth. The site servers need no account and no API key. payping-mcp and bale-mcp work on your own account with your token, and swapwallet-mcp with your SwapWallet sign-in.

Claude Code plugins (server + skill, pick what you want): add the marketplace once, then choose servers in the /plugin Discover tab, or install by name.

claude plugin marketplace add sepehr071/iran-mcp
claude plugin install digikala@iran-mcp            # one server
claude plugin install iran-travel@iran-mcp         # a bundle: food, shopping, cars, travel, maps, jobs, ...
claude plugin install iran-all@iran-mcp            # every read-only site server

claude plugin install <name> --marketplace sepehr071/iran-mcp does both steps in one command. payping, bale and swapwallet act on your own account, so no bundle includes them; install them by name. SwapWallet also publishes this server as its own plugin (swapwallet@swapwallet, from SwapWallet/swapwallet-mcp), with the same rules. Install one of the two: with both you get the server twice.

Skills for other agents (Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, ...): pick the skills you want, then add each server with the config below.

npx skills add sepehr071/iran-mcp

Grok Build reads the same marketplace: grok plugin marketplace add sepehr071/iran-mcp, then install servers one by one (Grok doesn't install a bundle's members). Which agent supports what: PLUGINS.md.

One server (Claude Code, without the plugin):

claude mcp add digikala -- uvx digikala-mcp
claude mcp add --transport http swapwallet https://swapwallet.app/mcp   # hosted; then sign in from /mcp
claude mcp add --transport http pasavard https://pasavard.ir/api/mcp      # hosted, no sign-in

Any MCP client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, ...):

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "digikala": { "command": "uvx", "args": ["digikala-mcp"] },
    "jabama":   { "command": "uvx", "args": ["jabama-mcp"] }
  }
}

swapwallet-mcp is added by URL, and each client takes a URL in its own shape (Windsurf uses serverUrl, Claude Desktop takes it under Settings → Connectors): see its setup for each client.

All 72 at once: clone this repo and open it in Claude Code. The .mcp.json at the root registers every server; approve the ones you want.

git clone https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-mcp
cd iran-mcp && claude

[!TIP] 896 tools is a lot of context. Enable the servers for the task at hand rather than all of them.
